nodes.label: WS-SUPV-2026 workbook
nodes.rationale: Supervisor (SV/AS) weekly checklist workbook for 2026: one template sheet, one Area Manager task sheet, and one sheet per supervisor keyed by WS payroll ID.

nodes.label: CHECKLIST SV (template sheet)
nodes.rationale: Blank master copy of the weekly checklist; every per-person sheet is a copy of it, so all month blocks show #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: Checklist Mingguan (SA/CA/PT/TJH)
nodes.rationale: Weekly supervisor checklist form title; the SA/CA/PT/TJH tag names the staff grades it applies to.

nodes.label: Score scale N/A, 1-5
nodes.rationale: Column A list (N/A,1,2,3,4,5) feeds the score dropdown; each perkara line is marked out of 5, N/A lines are left blank and drop out of the denominator.

nodes.label: Monthly block (MONTH header, WEEK 1-4, TARIKH, NAMA)
nodes.rationale: Each sheet repeats a 43-row block per month Jan-Dec 2026 with four weekly column pairs; TARIKH row holds the visit date and NAMA the marker.

nodes.label: MANAGER column (Manager verification mark)
nodes.rationale: Second mark per week intended for the Manager; in every filled month it stays empty (0), so MGR % is #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: JUMLAH MARKAH and % row
nodes.rationale: Per week: sum of marks, max possible (lines marked x 5), and percentage; month average split into SV/AS and MGR.

nodes.label: Monthly summary table (MONTH / SV/AS / MGR)
nodes.rationale: Top-right table pulls each month's SV/AS and MGR averages from the month blocks; acts as the sheet's year view.

nodes.label: Perkara 7: KEAADAAN KEDAI
nodes.rationale: Spelled KEAADAAN (typo for KEADAAN) in the source.

nodes.label: Perkara 12: DISPLAY BARANG PROMOSI DI TEMPAT VVIP
Perkara 13: AMBIL PERHATIAN PESANAN DALAM GROUP
Blank N/A lines pattern (PERIKSA METER SUBLOT, LAIN-LAIN)
nodes.rationale: Item 11 and 14D are never marked in any filled week, so the max is 17 lines x 5 = 85 rather than 19 x 5; blank lines are treated as N/A and excluded from the denominator.

nodes.label: Empty MANAGER column pattern (MGR #DIV/0!)
nodes.rationale: In every filled month only the AM column has marks; the MANAGER column total is 0/0 so MGR % and monthly MGR average are #DIV/0!. Manager verification is designed but not practised.

nodes.label: #DIV/0! on unfilled or partial months
nodes.rationale: Months with no marks show #DIV/0! in the summary; July 2026 is also #DIV/0! because weeks 2-4 were left blank while the Area Manager was opening a new branch, so one missed week breaks the monthly average.

nodes.label: Mark typed into CATATAN row (July WS0001)
nodes.rationale: WS0001 July week 1 has a 4 in the JADUAL PEKERJA CATATAN row, inflating totals to 72/90 instead of 68/85; free-form sheet cells let notes rows be scored.

nodes.label: SV/AS (Supervisor / Assistant Supervisor)
nodes.rationale: The person marked by this checklist; summary column SV/AS holds their monthly average.

nodes.label: Staff grades SA/CA/PT/TJH
nodes.rationale: Grades named in the form title; meaning of each abbreviation not given in the source.

nodes.label: HERDI (Area Manager, marker)
nodes.rationale: Only name in the NAMA row of every filled week and in DIISIKAN OLEH on the Area Manager task sheet.

nodes.label: WS staff ID sheet naming (WSnnnn_NAME)
nodes.rationale: Per-person sheets are named by WS-prefixed payroll ID plus name, making the ID the stable key for a supervisor.

nodes.label: <BACK navigation link
nodes.rationale: Hyperlink cell on each sheet and month block, implying an index/menu sheet not present in this export.

nodes.label: Tugasan Area Manager form
nodes.rationale: Monthly AM task log with four weekly TICK/CATATAN/TARIKH PEMERIKSAAN column triples; source header misspells MANGER.

nodes.label: A) PETI CASH (cash box check)
nodes.rationale: Filled weeks record the float amount 4000 in CATATAN.

nodes.label: B) X REPORT (POS sales report check)
nodes.rationale: Filled weeks record SALES OK.

nodes.label: DIPERIKSA OLEH (checked by) - always empty
nodes.rationale: Verification signature row is never filled in any month, mirroring the empty MANAGER column on the checklist: the second-person check is designed but unused.

nodes.label: BUKA KEDAI BARU MACHANG UPTOWN (July 2026)
nodes.rationale: Note written in weeks 2-4 of July on both the AM task sheet and the supervisor sheets, explaining why those weeks were not marked.

hyperedges.label: Marks entered by Area Manager only, Manager verification never filled
Weekly score: perkara marks out of 5, N/A lines excluded, summed to JUMLAH MARKAH and averaged into monthly summary
Machang Uptown opening left July weeks 2-4 unmarked
